opening.argument: The speaker leads with an instructional promise to explain seven ways to make money online, then describes how Google AdSense places ads on websites, blogs, or YouTube videos and pays when visitors click. That is an explanation of an online business model, not a promise that viewers will earn a guaranteed return. The invitation to register for a free masterclass is promotional, and the speaker cites past subscriber growth and YouTube income, but the supplied evidence establishes no payment requirement, private-data requirement, or deceptive condition. Those personal results are not verified, and neither is the linked destination; they should not be treated as proven outcomes for viewers.
